name: groovesheet
description: Find sheet music, MIDI and isolated stems for songs in GrooveSheet's library of AI transcriptions.

interface.longDescription:
GrooveSheet is a library of songs transcribed by AI into readable sheet music, MIDI and isolated stems (drums, bass, piano, guitar, vocals and the rest of the mix).

Ask ChatGPT for a song and GrooveSheet finds it, tells you exactly which parts have a readable score and which have MIDI only, and gives you the links: the song page to play every separated part in the browser, and the sheet music page for each scored part.

Examples:
- "Find drum sheet music for Dynamite by BTS."
- "Which parts of Easy On Me by Adele have sheet music?"
- "What Bruno Mars songs are on GrooveSheet?"

Reading and playing need no account. Downloads (PDF, Guitar Pro, stems, MIDI, MusicXML) need a free GrooveSheet account on the song page. This app only searches the library and returns links: it never uploads, changes or deletes anything.

Which parts of Easy On Me by Adele have sheet music?
What Bruno Mars songs are on GrooveSheet?

positive.description: Find a song's drum score and its download links
positive.prompt: Find drum sheet music for Dynamite by BTS.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Dynamite by BTS and returns the song page and the drums sheet music page for the drum part. Notes that downloads (PDF, Guitar Pro, stems, MIDI, MusicXML) need a free account on the song page.

positive.description: Report which parts of a song are scored
positive.prompt: Which parts of Easy On Me by Adele have readable sheet music?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists drums, piano, bass and the chord chart as having sheet music, and gives the song page link.

positive.description: Browse an artist's songs in the library
positive.prompt: What Bruno Mars songs are on GrooveSheet?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the Bruno Mars songs in the library (Talking to the Moon, Just the Way You Are, When I Was Your Man, Grenade) with a link to each song page.

positive.description: Get the PDF for one scored part
positive.prompt: Get me the piano PDF for The Scientist by Coldplay.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the song page and the piano sheet music page for The Scientist, and says the PDF downloads there after a free sign-in.

positive.description: Be accurate when a part has MIDI only
positive.prompt: Is there piano sheet music for Bohemian Rhapsody on GrooveSheet?
positive.expected_behavior: Says the piano part of Bohemian Rhapsody has a MIDI transcription but no readable score, and that drums, bass, guitar and the chord chart do have sheet music. Does not call the piano MIDI sheet music.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Tokyo tomorrow?

negative.description: Music theory question that needs no song lookup
negative.prompt: Explain what a time signature of 6/8 means.
Which electronic drum kit should I buy for under $500?

publication.release_notes: First release: search GrooveSheet's library and get sheet music, PDF, Guitar Pro and song page links. No sign-in needed.
